scope: All 47 original PNGs personally viewed. Eleven current3121 medium cases with requested seed20261005, actual WASD, original normal FOV/light/pressure and no tools equipped; live recipe, viewport, facing and body-route checks retained. No new runtime edits.
limitations: Only illuminated local faces and material relationships shown; not complete-map, search-return, economy, dynamic fatigue, audio or human approval.

Original 43 camera goals for ten repaired worlds plus four woven goals are unchanged. The prior body30 checks validate author intent routes/24px stations; they are not a point-for-point pretest of all 43 camera goals. This capture records actual movement and facing separately.
Actual poses/pressure differ from original rejected images; comparisons are not pixel-aligned. Real enemy occlusion, damage and darkness are retained.
Low/severe validation remains pending for all eleven repaired worlds. Previous rejected raw images/source identities remain unchanged.

worlds.finding: 01低母床不再整圈硬切；02/03中间压口仍有厚面并与母床接近；04/05上下离断片保留，未把两离片改写成连接母层。

worlds.finding: 01/02厚短束的方向和聚组清楚；03两团之间裸床可辨；04原米色四边低尾硬边已退为贴地过渡，未改变高断束轮廓。
limitations: 04有敌人遮挡近侧一部分；低尾与地面色差仍存在，不能按一帧推断全尾边均受审。

worlds.finding: 02/05原浅脂片闭合边与直角拼缝消失，粉色薄层向蓝床贴地过渡；01/04高厚头仍有连续曲面和清楚脚沿。
limitations: 02敌人遮部分低面；03主要照见中间床，不作为全部低片轮廓证据。

worlds.finding: 01/03粒肩压膜的厚薄关系保留；01/04灰低面不再露完整黑色多边形环或尖纸边，中央裸裂床与高灰卷面可区分。

worlds.finding: 01/04浅灰母床的整圈黑切边消失，04近脚薄沿贴回地面；02/03蓝色高短体的暗面、亮断端与低床仍分离。
limitations: 03上部材料色界较直；04只证明近侧浅沿与右侧真缺地分离，不签母床全部外沿。
